title: Playboy January 1986 Andy Warhol Holiday Anniversary Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Front cover bright and clean with no creases or tears; spine intact. Back cover has edge wear and a small chip/scuffing at the lower right corner (see photo 3). Complete with centerfold. Note: the Warhol signature on the cover is printed as part of the cover art, not hand-signed. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 1986 - Holiday Anniversary Issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Iconic Andy Warhol pop-art Rabbit Head cover (the signature is printed as part of the artwork).

Back cover: Nissan 300 ZX ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
